internal_diagnostics: VEN_ID = 0x014C, DEV_ID = 0x0410, REV_ID (revision) — identify silicon presence via I2C.
CFG register mirrors DATA[23:16] strap state — 8 bits of host-visible configuration data.
RSEN (Receiver Sense) — source-side DC current sense on TX0 detects a powered receiver (DC-coupled only).
HTPLG (Hot-Plug Detect) — samples receiver-supplied HPD line.
MDI (Monitor Detect Interrupt) — fires on RSEN or HTPLG change (per TSEL).
MSEN open-drain output — externally observable status of MDI / RSEN / HTPLG (per MSEL[3:1]).
H_RES counter — horizontal resolution (pixels per line) measured by counting between HSYNC pulses.
V_RES counter — vertical resolution (lines per frame) measured by counting between VSYNC pulses.
TDIS bit — disable TMDS circuitry while keeping PLL locked, for fast gating.
VEN / HEN bits — gate VSYNC / HSYNC transmission for test stim.
PD bit — full power-down for ATE.

scan_topology.standard_scan_chain_present: Not exposed in datasheet (production-test architecture is TI-internal).
scan_topology.BIST_present: No spec-defined BIST. Receiver-side compliance test patterns from DVI / HDMI CTS provide black-box test coverage.
scan_topology.I2C_register_check: Round-trip write/read of CTL_1_MODE / CTL_2_MODE / CTL_3_MODE / DE_* registers serves as I2C bus + register file BIST.
scan_topology.vendor_BIST_extensions: Some HDMI / DVI transmitter ICs (later TI parts, Synopsys IP) expose loopback / PRBS / eye-monitor modes; TFP410 does NOT expose such modes via the I2C register file documented in the datasheet.

fields.notes: TFP410 production characterization relies on parametric ATE testing (DC supply current, leakage, ESD) and lab-bench TMDS eye / timing measurements against the DVI Compliance Test Specification. The chip exposes a small but useful set of in-band test bits via I2C (RSEN, HTPLG, MDI, H_RES, V_RES, CFG, REV_ID) that allow runtime monitoring without dedicated DFT pins. JTAG and standard scan are not documented in the public datasheet.
